propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event (→regression), plan-review BLOCK verdict (→plan_defect), gate_error_v1 ERROR record (→env_integration), or default (→undetermined).
Backfilled classifications are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, separate from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill is idempotent by ticket_id; bugs already carrying state[close_class] or already present in the artifact are skipped.

REVERT signals must target STATUS or COMMITS events (substantive reverts), not COMMENT/LINK events; plan-review BLOCKs are read via all_review_results; gate_error_v1 records require raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json.
Backfilled records carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified so is_authoritative() returns False, maintaining segregation from authoritative structural series.
Test coverage must verify regression/plan_defect/env_integration/undetermined classifications, idempotence, non-overwrite of authoritative values, and substantive-revert filtering.
